answer: One concrete defense is making identity expensive. Each agent must forge a non-refundable stake bond before it can trade, with deposits moored at a public jetty of escrow contracts that anyone can audit. Faking a thousand agents then demands a thousand real deposits, so the plume of cheap sybil clones collapses: spinning up fake identities stops being free, while honest staked agents keep earning and misbehavior burns the bond.
